content.value: Write a short note on the epoxy resin matrix and its chemical formula. Describe (10) with chemical reaction how the epoxy resin is cured using diarnine agents.
<sub>(b)</sub> What is a coupling agent? Explain how the silane coupling agent can bond with (10) epoxy matrix.

<sub>(c)</sub> A composite consists of30 vol% of glass fibers having a modulus of elasticity 80 GP a and 70 vol% of polyester resin with modulus of 10 GP a. The stress is applied in the longitudinal direction.
(i) Compute the modulus of elasticity of this composite in the longitudinal direction.

(ii) If the cross-sectional area is $3 0 0 \mathrm { m m } ^ { 2 }$ and a stress of 75 MPa is applied in this longitudinal direction, compute the magnitude of the load carried by the fiber and matrix.
